svg.title: EP2 C5 AREA 29
svg.desc: Matching colors: switches / fences Clock: timed switch Bulb: light control Green ring: healing Crossed squares: barriers / traps Box numbers: supply counts Letter / prime: warp pair Enter at the top and descend 9F → 1F, reversing the previous area’s floor direction. 8F: after Gibbles, flowers appear on both sides. Clear one side together to limit crossfire. 7F fixed units: Ogre/Power ×2 and General/Body ×2. 6F gatekeeper: Gi Gue. Continue down after clearing. 5F: move right on entry to contain Delbiter’s charge and focus the party’s attacks. 3F’s door is already open: pass through. In 2F, wait for the flowers before committing. Clear Epsilon on 1F to finish. Wait for a safe opening when its shields spread.
